sentinelValues.meaning: Same as omitting the parameter: applies to the current sheet.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns a collection of dirty-row objects describing rows of tableName modified since the last reset, and by default clears that dirty status.

constraints: Only modified columns bound to a data context are taken into account.
reset defaults to True: calling the command clears the dirty status of tableName unless False is passed.
sheet is 0-based; if omitted or -1 is passed, the command applies to the current sheet.
Returns an empty collection if tableName is not found or has no modified column.
Each returned dirty-row object has item (modified object), originalItem (object before modification), and row (0-based modified row index).
